items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-10-02
items.q: worse pirate player than Ted Lewis. Sorry. He was fierce. And I was his official bass player.

ctx.x: Do you remember George Brunis? Oh yeah, I remember George, yeah. George. Well, George with Ted Lewis.

In fact I played with Ted Lewis down in the room there. But George wasn't there then. George had left him. He came down to New Orleans and he stayed by, and he went over to the Gulf Coast there, with a couple of bands. In fact I played a couple of jobs with him on the bass fiddle, you know, and he was playing some ball. George was not on, he didn't read music. He didn't know anything about music.
